bounded_notes: SOURCE review only: no mujoco/numpy import, MjModel/MjData, physical step, saved numerical trajectory read or backend execution by reviewer. Production runner imports/executes these only when Root separately invokes it.

Native contact force6 is local native-contact-frame evidence at the POST state, recomputed with the just-ended interval force still installed. In particular the record at1.2s holds the preceding active interval force; it is not the next force-free interval force solution. Do not integrate these diagnostic POST forces as physical solver-PRE impulses or call them world-frame forces. Contact.frame is not saved; no world force/torque reconstruction is qualified.

Initial forward1/case and post-step explicit forward1/step are separately counted. Native mj_step internal work is not thereby measured as independent backend API calls. Warp parity requires equivalent declared sampling and initial conditions.

max_speed_m_s diagnostic currently uses freejoint root-origin speed; COM-rest gates use correctly saved jacobian-based world COM velocity. An independent evaluator should use COM arrays for COM metrics.

The runner emits recording evidence with thresholds_assessed=false, not a complete phone_physics_stage1_result gate assessment. Future saved-only evaluation must assess all protocol gates, compare time steps, bind execution/geometry/source evidence, and preserve every failed or missing backend case.
Geometry error is already outside the predeclared geometry bound. Numerical stability, if subsequently observed, cannot override geometry_qualified=false or become real parameter calibration.
